name: Being Lucky
overview: Scripture reveals that what some may call 'luck' is ultimately governed by the sovereign hand of the Lord, as seen in Proverbs 16:33 where the casting of the lot is controlled by God. True prosperity and success come from meditating on and obeying God's law (Joshua 1:8), rather than relying on chance. While life includes elements of time and chance (Ecclesiastes 9:11), blessings are promised to the faithful (Proverbs 28:20), and wisdom and virtue hold far greater value than wealth or fleeting favor (Proverbs 31:10). The infinite understanding and power of God (Psalms 147:5) assure believers that their path is directed by His perfect will, not by random fortune.
